name: Hot Tub
description: Live hot tub status from Home Assistant over MQTT, in the arcade style of the NBA and NFL Live plugins: status header, gradient temperature panel with arcade numerals, a tub scene where the water rises toward the set point with waves, bubbles and steam, heater/filter/jets indicators, a fault screen and a READY burst.
author: Custom

versions.changes: Redesign in the NBA/NFL Live style: shared 3x5 pixel font and drawing kit, tub scene with live water level, FAULT hazard screen, READY burst. Replaces the PressStart2P text layout. LaMetric icon options removed.

Arcade restyle to match media-marquee: PressStart2P on 8px rows, segmented approach bar, blinking ERROR and NO DATA attract screen. Water animation removed. font_path and font_antialias options removed.
Added a heater indicator (flame, lit while actively heating) alongside filter and bubbles.
Larger label, status and target text -- the previous sizes were hard to read on the panel. Layout restacked to suit.

Configurable font (defaults to DejaVu Sans Mono Bold) with per-size caching, and crisp non-antialiased text rendering by default. Filter now drawn as a cartridge icon, with optional LaMetric icon support like bubbles.

Animated water rendering: tub fills as the water approaches target, live wave surface, bubbles rising when on, steam while heating. Bubbles now shown as a three-level gauge (off/medium/high) rather than on/off.
